_inputs: Track B COP sprite — PARTIAL 3-clip set (walk/run/attack; NO idle, NO hurt — deferred Meshy gen). Reuses the PROVEN thug GLB pipeline. Stage the 3 textured GLBs in assets/raw/cop_glb/ (gitignored); the A-pose Character_output.glb can stay in the folder (it has no walk/run/attack keyword, so keyword-resolve ignores it). Filenames: leave the Meshy '..._Animation_Walking/Running/Punch_Combo_1_withSkin.glb' names OR rename to walk.glb/run.glb/attack.glb — the literals below are short; if missing, the renderer keyword-resolves (walk / run / punch) within the folder. source=glb keeps each GLB's PBR Material_1 (keepSourceMaterial); viewTransform=Standard = true colour. inPlace strips locomotion travel (Z bob kept). SHARED SCALE across the 3 clips via the bbox union AND locked to fixedOrthoScale 2.8284 (output) so the cop matches props/kit at 8 px/ft. STEP 0: run inspect_fbx (GLB mode) FIRST and confirm each action name + frame range (watch a non-zero start); pin actions[].actionName / sourceFrameStart / sourceFrameEnd here ONLY if inspect shows a multi-action file or a dead lead-in. dirOffset reuse THUG_FACING_OFFSET(+4) is applied at runtime, not here — K eyeballs facing (fresh model, axis may differ).
_run: Windows PowerShell, SPLIT STREAMS: $ErrorActionPreference='Continue'; & $env:BLENDER_PATH -b -P tools\blender\render_iso_unit.py -- --job tools\blender\render_jobs\cop.json --engine BLENDER_EEVEE 1> cop_render.out 2> cop_render.err ; then paste cop_render.out. Expect 3x IMPORTED/DROP Icosphere/KEEP source material/MATERIAL principled=True, a LOCKED-SCALE + FIXED-SCALE ortho_scale=2.8284 line, 3x SHEET rows=8, RENDER_OK actions=3 dirs=8. Commit RAW — NO pngquant (destroys photoreal).

camera._note: Same lock as the thug: 2:1 tiles -> dimetric2to1 (60deg from top-down), Z=45. Facing corrected at runtime via unitSpriteView dirOffset (THUG_FACING_OFFSET=4); if the cop faces wrong, that offset may need its own value — K eyeballs (fresh model).
